    47	public:
    48	
    49	  // Constructor.
    50	  Dict(XRef *xrefA);
    51	  Dict(const Dict *dictA);
    52	  Dict *copy(XRef *xrefA) const;

    55	  Dict& operator=(const Dict &) = delete;

    57	  // Get number of entries.
    58	  int getLength() const { return static_cast<int>(entries.size()); }
    59	
    60	  // Add an entry. (Copies key into Dict.)
    61	  // val becomes a dead object after the call
    62	  void add(const char *key, Object &&val);
    63	
    64	  // Add an entry. (Takes ownership of key.)
    65	  void add(char *key, Object &&val) = delete;
    66	
    67	  // Update the value of an existing entry, otherwise create it
    68	  // val becomes a dead object after the call
    69	  void set(const char *key, Object &&val);
    70	  // Remove an entry. This invalidate indexes
    71	  void remove(const char *key);
    72	
    73	  // Check if dictionary is of specified type.
    74	  bool is(const char *type) const;
    75	
    76	  // Look up an entry and return the value.  Returns a null object
    77	  // if <key> is not in the dictionary.
    78	  Object lookup(const char *key, int recursion = 0) const;
    79	  // Same as above but if the returned object is a fetched Ref returns such Ref in returnRef, otherwise returnRef is Ref::INVALID()

    81	  // Look up an entry and return the value.  Returns a null object
    82	  // if <key> is not in the dictionary or if it is a ref to a non encrypted object in a partially encrypted document
    83	  Object lookupEnsureEncryptedIfNeeded(const char *key) const;
    84	  const Object &lookupNF(const char *key) const;
    85	  bool lookupInt(const char *key, const char *alt_key, int *value) const;
    86	
    87	  // Iterative accessors.
    88	  const char *getKey(int i) const { return entries[i].first.c_str(); }
    89	  Object getVal(int i) const { return entries[i].second.fetch(xref); }
    90	  // Same as above but if the returned object is a fetched Ref returns such Ref in returnRef, otherwise returnRef is Ref::INVALID()
    91	  Object getVal(int i, Ref *returnRef) const;
    92	  const Object &getValNF(int i) const { return entries[i].second; }
    93	
    94	  // Set the xref pointer.  This is only used in one special case: the
    95	  // trailer dictionary, which is read before the xref table is
    96	  // parsed.
    97	  void setXRef(XRef *xrefA) { xref = xrefA; }
    98	  
    99	  XRef *getXRef() const { return xref; }
   100	  
   101	  bool hasKey(const char *key) const;

   103	private:

   106	  // Reference counting.
   107	  int incRef() { return ++ref; }
   108	  int decRef() { return --ref; }
